title: dispatch-witness-record
description: Cell-shape of the witness line every dispatch-layer skill appends to code/logs/tool-uses/YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl when work crosses its boundary. Required cells: ts, skill, workitem-skill, workitem-kind, chosen-receiver, outcome. Optional cells: error (required when outcome is error), attempts (per-candidate fall-through record at the model picker), length (response byte count at terminal ok). Per the dispatch-witness-record spec, one workitem flowing through the layered chain produces one line per layer; the shared workitem-skill and workitem-kind cells let replays group by workitem.

ts.description: ISO 8601 timestamp the witness was appended.

skill.description: Slug of the dispatch-layer skill emitting the witness.

workitem-skill.description: The skill cell of the workitem this layer was processing. Null is permitted at lower layers that do not yet receive the full workItem; Phase C9 makes this non-null at every layer.

chosen-receiver.description: Slug or repo-relative path of the receiver this layer routed to. Null when no receiver was chosen (terminal error before pick).

error.description: Diagnostic string. Required when outcome is error.

attempts.description: Per-candidate fall-through record used by the model picker.

length.description: Byte length of the response text at terminal ok outcomes.
